Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles
From molecule_dictionary
Left Join compound_records On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Left Join compound_structures On compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Left Join docs On compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id
Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1151930'
Sort By molecule_chembl_id
